name: Crimson Agate
description: A type of crystal formed from the combination of concentrated life force with an energy unique to Dragonspine. Makes for an ideal nutrient for growing Frostbearing Trees.
fullDescription: A crystal formed from the combination of coalesced life force and the unique energies of Dragonspine. This will prove excellent nutrition for the Frostbearing Tree, which yearns to grow further.\nWhen the nail that froze Dragonspine descended, the trunk and canopy of this tree shattered into many fragments that were then frozen. A long time later, a black dragon fell into the valley and its blood seeped into the ley lines. And a long time after that, someone has broken the icy shackles, and the ancient tree that has absorbed that "crimson" has now sprouted anew...
